name: Cubing with the Viking 2017

venue.name: Ellison Campus Center, Salem State University
venue.details: The competition is in Veterans Hall, which is on the second floor of the Ellison Campus Center.

information: There is a 110 competitor limit for this competition.  The Ellison Campus Center is #10 on the map which can be found [here](https://newsite.salemstate.edu/sites/default/files/pdfs/SSU_MAP_08_16_Parking.pdf).  Money raised from this competition will be going toward the SSU Community Service Group in order to assist those affected by Hurricane Harvey in Texas.
